description_en: Queries time-series information about quota resource consumption
description_zh: 查看quota资源消耗的时序信息
name: QueryQuotaMetric

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query time range. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询时间范围：开始时间。格式为 Unix 时间戳，单位为秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query time range. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询时间范围：结束时间。格式为 Unix 时间戳，单位为秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The name of the observed metric. Valid values: cpu and memory
parameters.help_zh: 观测指标名称。仅支持cpu和memory
parameters.name: metric

parameters.help_en:
The data aggregation policy. Default value: max. Valid values: max and avg.

Data is collected every 1 minute. If the query time range is large, the adaptive step size for data display exceeds 1 minute, and the metrics are aggregated. This parameter specifies the data aggregation logic
parameters.help_zh:
数据聚合策略。默认max。仅支持max和avg。

数据的采集频率是1分钟。当查询的时间范围较大时，数据展示的自适应步长会超过1分钟，此时指标会进行聚合。该参数即指定数据的聚合逻辑
parameters.name: strategy

parameters.help_en:
The fixed interval in seconds. By default, this parameter is empty, which indicates that the adaptive interval policy of the system is used.
Adaptive interval policy: The interval is 60 seconds if the query time range is within 6 hours, 300 seconds if within 24 hours, 900 seconds if within 72 hours, and 1800 seconds if exceeding 72 hours.
Specified interval: Only 60, 300, and 900 are supported. The query time range must be within 72 hours
parameters.help_zh:
固定间隔，单位为秒。默认为空，表示使用系统自适应间隔策略。
自适应间隔策略：查询时间范围在6小时内时间隔60s，24小时内时300s，72小时内时900s，超过72小时则1800s。
指定间隔：仅支持60，300，900。且要求查询间隔在72小时内
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en: The nickname of the level-1 quota. This parameter is required
parameters.name: nickname

parameters.help_en: The nickname of the level-2 quota
parameters.name: sub_quota_nickname

additionalProperties.description_en:
The metric metadata information.
unit: The metadata unit. If the metric is cpu, the unit is Core. If the metric is memory, the unit is GB.
type: The metadata type. 
If the queried metric category is cpu, the metadata types include totalMaxCpu, totalUsedCpu, adhocCpu, adhocUsedCpu, maxCpu, minCpu, requestCpu, usedCpu, elasticMaxCpu, and elasticUsedCpu.
If the queried metric category is memory, the metadata types include totalMaxMem, totalUsedMem, adhocMem, adhocUsedMem, elasticMaxMem, elasticUsedMem, maxMem, minMem, and usedMem
additionalProperties.description_zh:
指标元数据信息。
unit：元数据单位。指标为cpu时，单位是Core。指标为memory时，单位是GB。
type：元数据类型。查询指标类别为cpu时，元数据类型包括totalMaxCpu、totalUsedCpu、adhocCpu、adhocUsedCpu、maxCpu、minCpu、requestCpu、usedCpu、elasticMaxCpu、elasticUsedCpu。查询指标类别为memory时，元数据类型包括totalMaxMem、totalUsedMem、adhocMem、adhocUsedMem、elasticMaxMem、elasticUsedMem、maxMem、minMem、usedMem

items.description_en: The length is 2. The elements are the timestamp and the value
items.description_zh: 长度为2，分别是时间戳和数值

items.description_zh: 长度为2，分别是时间戳和数值

name.description_en: The name of the observed metric

period.description_en: The step size of the monitoring data

httpCode.description_en:
The HTTP status code.
1xx: Informational. The request was received and is being processed.
2xx: Success. The request was successfully received, understood, and accepted by the server.
3xx: Redirection. The request was redirected, and further action is required to complete it.
4xx: Client error. The request contains bad syntax, invalid parameters, or cannot be fulfilled.
5xx: Server error. The server failed to fulfill the request due to other reasons
httpCode.description_zh:
HTTP状态码。
1xx：信息响应 - 请求已接收，正在处理中。
2xx：成功 - 请求动作已被服务端成功接收、理解并接受。
3xx：重定向 - 请求被重定向，采取进一步行动以完成请求。
4xx：客户端错误 - 请求包含错误请求参、语法或特定请求条件无法满足。
5xx：服务端错误 - 服务器由于其他原因无法满足请求
